info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Customer Offer-spec
info.description: The Customer Offer Creation API enables businesses to generate tailored offers for customers in the sales process. This endpoint facilitates the input of customer details and offer characteristics, aiming to engage potential buyers effectively. Companies can utilize this API to enhance their marketing strategies and improve customer onboarding experiences. Typical users are sales teams and marketing departments seeking to optimize their customer interaction and conversion rates.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new offer specifically tailored for a customer. You can specify various parameters to define the offer details, catering to the customer's needs and preferences.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the creation of a customer offer. It should contain the necessary information required for processing the offer and can include details such as customer data, offer specifics, and related metadata.
